notes: Andrew, 2026-10-26 (night): "I think we need something like a ruggable so that it's thin enough and separate from the padding to allow actually washing"; then "What color / size for each room? tell me". Ruggable Flatwoven Two-Piece (ruggable.com, read in Chrome 2026-10-26; no photo: the host is off the image allowlist): "Our original 2-piece 2mm (~1/16") low-pile system is made for high-traffic areas & low-clearance doors. All sizes home machine washable." Specifications: Construction Flatwoven; Rug Pad: Required, Standard or Cushioned; Backing: Cling Effect for the pad; Thickness 2 mm (low); Feel smooth, firm; Material 100% polyester. "Machine-washable cover fits in a home washing machine, even in larger sizes"; "Robot vacuums are not recommended, as they may damage rug edges or corners"; roll, don't fold, to store. Made to order, ships free in 1 to 2 weeks. The "Rug & Pad System" price shown with the size (the pad type is chosen at checkout and its surcharge, if any, was not read): 4x6 $209, 5x7 $239, 8x10 $579, 9x12 $729, the same on every flatwoven design read (Impasto, Cyrus, Cambria, Hendesi, Calabria); a "Rug Cover" alone is sold for owners of a pad. Color "Beige & Blue", filed under Blue / Bohemian: the Cyrus bordered Persian in beige with blue; 1,103 reviews at 4.7. Opened for the flatwoven system's facts and the 8x10 price; not kept (F-03): beige with blue is neither the dining room's gray-and-ivory nor the bedroom's warm cream (F-68), and the Cambria Abalone covers the Persian-in-gray slot.
